token_document_target.name: token_document_target
token_document_target.value: ("client_access_tokens"."purpose" = 'QUESTIONS' AND "client_access_tokens"."scope_id" IS NULL AND "client_access_tokens"."change_id" IS NULL) OR ("client_access_tokens"."purpose" = 'SCOPE' AND "client_access_tokens"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL AND "client_access_tokens"."change_id" IS NULL) OR ("client_access_tokens"."purpose" = 'CHANGE' AND "client_access_tokens"."change_id" IS NOT NULL AND "client_access_tokens"."scope_id" IS NULL)
